question.text: A Cat III AIF's investor reporting and distribution materials should include:

answer.text: Annual reports (where applicable), risk factors, fee/expense disclosures, investor reporting mechanism, and performance/benchmark information

explanation.text: The Logic: Fund administrators prepare and distribute annual reports (p. 81), and investor-facing materials cover benchmark comparison, fee structure, investor reporting mechanism and risk factors (pp. 338, 341, 344). The Trap: Narrow communications focused only on SEBI filings, returns or fund size omit material the distributor and manager are expected to disclose. Note: Risk factors and fee/expense disclosures sit alongside performance reporting; do not present returns in isolation.
